email_subject: Possible adverse event report - Demo-Gluca patient with mild nausea

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 65-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their first dose of Demo-Gluca (dose: 10mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-01-10.
Approximately 10 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild nausea.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
D. Petrov (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
